reviews.classification: Bounded historical source-audit map or connected report; static evidence separated from gameplay
reviews.disposition: The full coverage map and report preserve recovered scripts versus selected function-body reading, missing resources and scene signals. Automatic fight/manual skills/rest, directed affix currencies and remembered encounter state are useful references. Daily/weekly counters lack a checked clock in the inspected handlers, gear Ascend/Rebirth labels are not character prestige, and a New Game delete is not an offline/reset policy. No timestamp/catch-up in the selected save code is a bounded source finding, not an absolute claim about all native extensions. Neither rendered UI, timer duration, item numerical data, game/save execution nor current uninstall state is established. The old uninstall request remains unconfirmed in its final dated receipt.

reviews.disposition: The full map and report preserve a repeated authored survival opening, retained instinct/artifact/automation progression and replaced run stock/buildings, without attributing randomized births or heirs to this donor. Active survival/health decay and offline actions that may end a life are donor-specific rules. Empty work pauses its life; unlock-by-repetition and manual-first automation are not required OOPS gates. No current pacing, family/age absence, accessibility, actual save/migration or decoder semantic-equivalence proof follows from indexed records and selected method bodies. The reported12/69/53/307/11records and18037formatted lines do not become a full manual review. Current AD52 permits useful routines without a universal manual prerequisite and permits long lives; local survival dials remain distinct. The old installed-files-available sentence is historical, not current installation authority.

reviews.classification: Bounded historical source-audit map or connected report; static evidence separated from gameplay
reviews.disposition: The full map/report preserve ordinary practice, social access, work/spending, power quality, prepared confrontation and three different reset layers. Six selected chains are not a full118-file semantic audit. All23public/installed paths lacked raw equality,19matched after line-ending normalization and three present files had semantic packaging/Steam/documentation differences;149selected ranges had148matches and one historical script-tag difference. These checks support their declared scopes, not whole-program equivalence or runtime performance. Steam load can attempt cloud recovery while the normal save-call remains commented out; a bridge is not verified synchronization. Base elapsed/base-tick caps precede a speed-multiplied inner loop, so they do not prove bounded total work. MECHANICS estimates,50uses,two-month timing and perfect Genesis retention remain unverified. C6 UI availability is distinct from the controller confirmation check. Public MIT provenance does not resolve the installed package UNLICENSED declaration. The final dated uninstall receipt supersedes earlier unconfirmed requests without establishing current installation state.

reviews.classification: Bounded historical source-audit map or connected report; static evidence separated from gameplay
reviews.disposition: All five connected traces and their map values were reviewed. Study unlocks knowledge without supplying casting fuel; live cooldown, control and affordability remain separate. Fireball380mana/six-second cooldown/20autocast points are nominal distinct values, transformed before use; a Water wand recipe/equipped output is not the same gate as learning or casting. Ordinary autocast points and permacast charging differ: charging may spend mana without an effect; a second listener can resume after income. A strategy estimate is not guaranteed transient affordability. Posterity Continue/world completion, two-click retirement and retained maxima replace run state without retaining every resource. Main584/423backend, vendor1236/1232withbody,91private decoded and18actually cited bodies are different denominators. This is the pinned2024public demo, not retail/DLC, all recovered modules or verified demo reachability. The report Decision describes a reference recommendation under AD32, not a new selected runtime slice.

reviews.disposition: The full map/report preserve study, scroll capacity, real furnishing/task effects, material-to-knowledge conversion and runner stop/resume as selected source-level contracts. Hall prestige preserves a lived character and supports character switching; it is not evidence that every prestige is forced rebirth. Community-source identity, redirected original repository and the unlocated user-open build remain distinct.594inventory files and loaded module lists do not prove every module initializes, all late progression or original-versus-community semantic parity. No current install, exact live version, offline numerical equivalence or rendered accessibility is certified. The24small touches are original OOPS proposals rather than donor features. Current opening priorities and AD52 qualify old preserve-vanilla-first/manual/tool/practice recommendations; actual superior means can replace ordinary work.
